leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply Ionic form components to construct a checkout interface with input fields and validation.
Implement Angular forms to manage user input data and validation states.
Use TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of checkout form data.
Execute form validation to check required fields and format correctness before submission.
Handle form submission events to process checkout data and trigger appropriate actions.
Utilize Ionic UI components to display validation feedback and error messages to users.
Construct reactive form controls to bind input elements to form data models.
Apply conditional rendering to show or hide form sections based on user selections.
Implement form reset functionality to clear all input fields after successful submission.
Use Angular services to manage form state and handle submission logic.
Control form accessibility by implementing proper labels, placeholders, and ARIA attributes.
Modify form layout using Ionic grid and CSS utilities to create responsive checkout designs.
